The re-dispatched backend lane on merged main (GitHub run 37216827342) fails at smart_construction_acceptance_fixture: TestAcceptanceFixtureExecutionFreeze.test_reconcile_project_company_repairs_rows_from_a_reused_database asserts res.company(3) != res.company(4) at line 134, before the reconciler is even called. Reproduced locally with the identical shape (289 != 290) in /tmp/freeze_orm.log. payment.request.company_id and sc.payment.execution.company_id are stored related fields on project_id.company_id; the test wrote the stale value with raw SQL and then invalidated the field, which makes the ORM recompute the related field from project_id instead of reading the stored column, so a warm-cache ORM read can never expose the stale value.

_reconcile_project_company now compares and repairs the stored company_id column itself (SQL read + SQL repair + cache invalidation) because the company-scoped list rules read that stored column; the test writes the stale value into the column and asserts the column is repaired, plus reconciler idempotence.
